text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia with lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, monocytosis, basophilia, and increased red cell distribution width. There is also low total CO₂, suggesting possible metabolic acidosis. Liver enzymes are significantly decreased. These findings may indicate bone marrow dysfunction or suppression, possible infection or inflammation, and impaired oxygenation. Clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
